notes.title: [BETA] VALKYRIE DRIVE -BHIKKHUNI- v1.05.00 Experimental Branch Update!
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone,

A new experimental beta patch for VALKYRIE DRIVE -BHIKKHUNI- has been released.

This latest patch, which can be accessed through the Beta Branch options, should fix the issue some users have been experiencing in regards to the Black Screen / Crash on Startup with NVIDIA graphic cards.

The branch is as follows:
branch: beta_debmenu 
pass: vddebug2017011800

If you experience any issues using this beta patch, or experience any other issues, then please let us know in the forum or by contacting us via support@marvelousgames.com

How to access [BETA] VALKYRIE DRIVE -BHIKKHUNI- v1.05.00


Open Steam Library
Right Click VALKYRIE DRIVE -BHIKKHUNI-
Navigate to 'Properties'
Select Tab 'BETA'
Enter the password: vddebug2017011800
Select 'Check Code'
Once authorised select 'beta_debmenu' 
VALKYRIE DRIVE -BHIKKHUNI- will update to v1.05.00
Note: Please try the fixes and let us know the results by emailing support@marvelousgames.com

notes.title: [BETA] VALKYRIE DRIVE -BHIKKHUNI- v1.03.00 Experimental Branch Update!
notes.notes:
Hello all,

A beta branch of VALKYRIE DRIVE -BHIKKHUNI- has been updated as follows:

[BETA] VALKYRIE DRIVE -BHIKKHUNI- v1.03.00

The following issues have been resolved:

Further corrections to issues wherein the game would crash on start-up
Further corrections to an issue wherein the game would start with no sound output
An issue wherein random sounds would be missing
An issue wherein an incorrect key icon was displayed in the Dressing Room
Erroneous text issues have been corrected


How to access [BETA] VALKYRIE DRIVE -BHIKKHUNI- v1.03.00


Open Steam Library
Right Click VALKYRIE DRIVE -BHIKKHUNI-
Navigate to 'Properties'
Select Tab 'BETA'
Enter the password: vddebug20170621
Select 'Check Code'
Once authorised select 'beta_log_test' 
VALKYRIE DRIVE -BHIKKHUNI- will update to v1.03.00
Note: Please try the fixes and let us know the results by emailing support@marvelousgames.com
